You are researching a live production codebase (read-only — do not modify anything) to build understanding for a design decision. Do NOT write any code or edit any files. This is pure research/reporting.

CONTEXT: Soul Pilates is a Pilates studio CRM (ASP.NET Core / .NET 10, C#, MongoDB, Astro frontend). The source lives on a remote server, NOT on this local machine. Access it via SSH:

    ssh -i ~/.ssh/soulpilates_deploy root@51.79.226.200 "cat /path/to/file"

or to grep across the repo:

    ssh -i ~/.ssh/soulpilates_deploy root@51.79.226.200 "grep -rn 'pattern' /opt/soulpilates/SoulPilates.Core"

The main repo is at /opt/soulpilates on that remote host (a .NET solution: SoulPilates.API, SoulPilates.Core, SoulPilates.Services, SoulPilates.Infrastructure). You'll need to run many ssh/grep/cat commands via Bash to explore — there's no local checkout, so plan on doing all reading through SSH command output.

YOUR FOCUS: the domain model for class types, products, and packages. I need exact, file:line-cited answers to:

1. **ClassBlueprint.Format** — find the actual entity file (SoulPilates.Core, likely Entities/ or similar). Is `Format` a C# enum or a string? What are ALL the defined values (the docs mention GROUP/PRIVATE/MAT — confirm exact enum member names and the file/enum definition)? Is there any existing notion of a "duo" or multi-person private class anywhere in this enum or nearby code (search for "Duo", "DUO", "duo" across the whole repo)?

2. **CalendarSession** — full field list relevant to pricing and capacity (Capacity, CurrentBookings, DropInPrice, Format). For PRIVATE-format sessions specifically, how is Capacity normally set (1? does it ever get set to 2)? Search for any special-casing of PRIVATE format capacity or pricing in blueprint or session creation code.

3. **Product / PackageBlueprint** — the sellable-item and package-definition entities. Exact fields (Type enum values, Credits, ValidityDays, Format field if any — does a package Product/PackageBlueprint carry a class Format so it can only be redeemed against that Format?). How does a Product link to a PackageBlueprint? Show the entity definitions.

4. **ClientPackage** (the purchased wallet instance) — exact fields again with types (Format, TotalCredits, CreditsUsed, CreditsRemaining, FractionalValuePerClass, Status enum values). Is `Format` a single value matching ClassBlueprint.Format, or could it represent something more granular (e.g., could it already support a notion of "how many people per credit")? Search for any field resembling headcount/party-size/duo/seats on ClientPackage or PackageBlueprint.

5. **Attendance** — exact fields, especially `Quantity`, `PackageInstanceId`, `AmountPaid`. Is `Quantity` used anywhere to represent "this booking is for N people" (e.g., a duo booking under one attendance with Quantity=2), or does each person always get their own Attendance row? Search usages of `Quantity` across Services/Controllers to see how it's actually used today.

6. Search the whole repo (grep -rni) for "duo", "Duo", "DUO", "couple", "partner class", "2 person", "two person" to see if there is ANY existing partial support for a duo/companion private class concept anywhere (entities, services, controllers, frontend, migrations, seed data).

Report back with: for each entity, the file path + exact field list (name, type) as it appears in code, and direct quotes/line numbers for anything relevant to a possible "Duo Private" concept. Flag clearly which of the above searches came back empty (i.e., confirmed this concept does NOT exist yet) versus which turned up something. Keep the report factual and structured — file:line citations for every claim. This report will be read by someone who needs to design a schema change, so precision matters more than prose.
